messages:
matt.sales: Heads-up: POC with NorthStar. Theyre seeing many events in the console with null trace_id. Their forwarder shows 403s for uploads and then we see 429s on ingest. Theyre on GCP and using impersonated service-account tokens + signed URLs.
anya.ops: Can you paste the forwarder/errors + one sample event?
matt.sales: Pasted (sanitized):
```
2026-08-11T10:21:02Z INFO batch=12 size=2.0MB generating signedURL
2026-08-11T10:21:03Z ERROR upload failed status=403 err="SignedUrlExpired" attempt=0
2026-08-11T10:21:03Z INFO refreshing token via impersonation target-service-account=northstar-fw@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
2026-08-11T10:21:05Z INFO retrying upload attempt=1
2026-08-11T10:21:07Z ERROR upload failed status=429 err="TooManyRequests" attempt=1
```
Sample event: `{ "ts":"2026-08-11T10:21:02Z", "msg":"http request","trace_id":null }`
raja.eng: Pattern: signed-url generation or token refresh happened mid-batch -> some objects failed with 403 (expired/invalid signed URL) while retries hit ingest rate limit -> metadata/body mismatch -> trace_id lost. Different root than STS but same symptoms.
lee-support: Customer asked if this is something they can fix quickly or needs our intervention. Need a one-liner for their SREs.
matt.sales: "Signed-URL/token refresh is happening mid-batch. Fix by increasing token lifetime or generate signed URLs per-object immediately before upload; short-term workaround: enable atomic/local buffering or smaller batch_size so refresh won't occur mid-batch."
anya.ops: Config options to give them (YAML snippet):
```
forwarder:
  buffer_mode: local
  signed_url_ttl_seconds: 900
  max_batch_size_mb: 1.0
  retry:
    max_attempts: 5
```
raja.eng: If they cannot change impersonation TTL we can: 1) switch to per-object signed URLs issued on-demand from their token issuer 2) route uploads through our signed-upload proxy (ent-only) 3) reduce batch size so rotation happens between batches.
lee-support: They also asked about cost/impact of a temporary ingest burst and whether it affects billing.
infra-bot: [quota] Temporary ingest burst granted org=northstar-42 ttl=2h by raja.eng :white_check_mark:
anya.ops: Short answer for billing: bursts are transient and visible on invoice as usage; we can note the temporary uplift in the POC quote. I'll loop in acct-team if they want itemized breakdown.
raja.eng: Follow-ups: 1) ops to scan for duplicates from local buffering 2) eng to add a detection rule that surfaces "signed-url/token refresh mid-batch" with a clearer error hint 3) sales to add GCP signed-URL guidance to the POC KB.
matt.sales: NorthStar toggled local buffering and reduced batch_size; they retried and report trace_ids returned for last 3 batches.
anya.ops: Running duplicate scan now; will post results in ~20m.
lee-support: I'll send the one-liner + YAML to their SRE and include note about burst billing. :thumbsup:
raja.eng: If this recurs we should add a small banner to the console that warns when >1% of recent batches had missing trace_id due to upload errors.
matt.sales: Thanks team, closing loop with customer and updating the KB.
